messages.content:
You are one investor on a team. Other investors with other styles and other data vote
separately; you do not see them. Your style:

You want revenue growth that is real and ideally accelerating, at a valuation that does not already price in perfection. Decelerating growth at a rich multiple is your sell signal.

You are shown a few stocks and, for each, ONLY the data your style uses (exact values computed by code).
For each stock give your conviction from -1 (strong sell or short) to +1 (strong buy); 0 means you abstain
(outside your style, or the data does not tell you enough). Abstaining is better than guessing.

Every reason must be anchored in the data you were shown:
- "field" is one of the field names shown for that stock, "value" repeats its value EXACTLY as shown;
- "point" is one sentence on why that value matters in your style; any number in it must be one of the
  values shown for that stock. Code deletes any reason that breaks these rules, and a non-zero vote with
  no surviving reason counts as an abstention.
- At most 3 reasons per stock. Use no outside knowledge about the companies.

Return JSON: {"votes": [{"symbol": str, "conviction": number, "reasons": [{"field": str, "value": str, "point": str}]}]}

{"stocks": [{"symbol": "EMA", "name": "EMERA INC", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "n/a", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "n/a", "revenue_growth_accel": "n/a", "ev_to_sales": "n/a", "operating_margin": "n/a", "mom_6m": "-12.3%"}}, {"symbol": "ARGX", "name": "ARGENX SE", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "n/a", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "n/a", "revenue_growth_accel": "n/a", "ev_to_sales": "n/a", "operating_margin": "n/a", "mom_6m": "+2.3%"}}, {"symbol": "NLY", "name": "ANNALY CAPITAL MANAGEMENT INC", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "n/a", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "n/a", "revenue_growth_accel": "n/a", "ev_to_sales": "n/a", "operating_margin": "n/a", "mom_6m": "-11.3%"}}, {"symbol": "DOC", "name": "HEALTHPEAK PROPERTIES, INC.", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "+23.3%", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "+45.4%", "revenue_growth_accel": "+10.9%", "ev_to_sales": "29.29", "operating_margin": "n/a", "mom_6m": "+14.4%"}}, {"symbol": "HRL", "name": "HORMEL FOODS CORP /DE/", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "+0.7%", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "-2.4%", "revenue_growth_accel": "-4.9%", "ev_to_sales": "1.05", "operating_margin": "+4.7%", "mom_6m": "-5.7%"}}]}

response: {"votes": [{"symbol": "EMA", "conviction": 0, "reasons": [{"field": "revenue_growth_yoy", "value": "n/a", "point": "Revenue growth data is missing, so I cannot judge if growth is real or accelerating."}]}, {"symbol": "ARGX", "conviction": 0, "reasons": [{"field": "revenue_growth_yoy", "value": "n/a", "point": "Revenue growth data is missing, so I cannot judge if growth is real or accelerating."}]}, {"symbol": "NLY", "conviction": 0, "reasons": [{"field": "revenue_growth_yoy", "value": "n/a", "point": "Revenue growth data is missing, so I cannot judge if growth is real or accelerating."}]}, {"symbol": "DOC", "conviction": 0, "reasons": [{"field": "revenue_growth_accel", "value": "+10.9%", "point": "The +10.9% acceleration means growth is accelerating, so the decelerating-growth sell signal is not triggered."}, {"field": "ev_to_sales", "value": "29.29", "point": "EV/Sales of 29.29 appears to price in perfection, so the valuation requirement for buying is not met."}]}, {"symbol": "HRL", "conviction": 0, "reasons": [{"field": "revenue_growth_q_yoy", "value": "-2.4%", "point": "The -2.4% quarterly revenue growth shows recent revenue decline, so growth is not real."}, {"field": "revenue_growth_accel", "value": "-4.9%", "point": "The -4.9% acceleration value indicates growth is decelerating, which is negative for my style."}, {"field": "ev_to_sales", "value": "1.05", "point": "EV/Sales of 1.05 is not a rich multiple, so the decelerating growth alone does not trigger my sell signal."}]}]}
